resources.string: Sync Fit3 health data to your Nextcloud
Connect to a Nextcloud server with the Health app installed. New Fit3 health data is synchronized automatically after each successful watch sync.
Syncs daily steps, pulse, oxygen saturation, and stress. Fit3 stress is converted from 1–100 into five equal bands for Nextcloud.

While connected, health data is synced about every 5 minutes. Each sync sends today’s step total and the latest pulse, oxygen, and stress readings; it does not backfill older history. Failed uploads retry every 5 minutes.
Create a device password in Nextcloud personal settings under Security
Use a device-specific app password, not your account password. It is encrypted with Android Keystore on this device.
